summary: TypeScript, CLI, MCP, packet, generated guidance, documentation, and regression searches confirm the named parallel-state public surface is removed; legacy CLI flags and commands fail explicitly.

Core and real-Git tests prove descriptive feature IDs and feature-local state, journal, locks, specifications, decisions, deltas, and evidence; linked checkouts progress without a root-state collision.

Schema-1, schema-2, and schema-3 fixtures migrate default root state and partition shared root journals by their recorded feature; interrupted migration resumes, missing contracts preserve source history, symbolic-link targets block, terminal legacy state permits a new feature, and alternate parallel data is not consumed.
CLI tests force the first-run interview, persist all five settings, prove it asks once, exercise empirical config, explicit flags, JSON, MCP, and non-interactive defaults.

A real Git repository test proves unrelated work returns a complete proposal with exact request, inferred type, base, branch, path, and argv while Git status and the target filesystem remain unchanged.

Real Git tests prove dirty-checkout blocking, base resolution, branch/path/registered-checkout collision rejection, approval-token integrity, stale active/base rejection, and exact shell-free git worktree add -b execution against the approved commit SHA without force.

Source and built-distribution real-worktree smoke tests verify the new checkout starts the exact request and returns absolute path, branch, base, feature, revision, workflow, first action, and resume command.
Decision parser/gate tests reject empty records, private-reasoning sections, malformed statuses and supersession; Complex Design blocks until a complete accepted decision and Review revalidates it.

API, human CLI, JSON CLI, MCP, and packed-consumer checks show matching read-only Explain state, next-action reason, context gaps, gate, and accepted summaries with no private trace fields; read-only open observes journal recovery without writing and requires explicit migration for legacy state.

bun run ci passed 56 source tests plus built distribution smoke covering Fast, Complex, Socratic Explore, Loop, exact revisions, evidence, Archive, deltas, policy, native/global integrations, lock recovery, and Windows retry classification.

Package/product report 0.20.0; typecheck, 56 tests, distribution smoke, isolated-cache package dry-run, 17-file tarball inspection, empty-consumer install, CLI init/Explain, real Git worktree, documentation searches, and git diff --check passed. Registry mutation remains correctly deferred until Review/Archive and publish verification.
